subject: Discrepancy on INV-20270601 — request for credit / corrected invoice
messages:
From: Marcel Dupont <accounting@holocene-analytics.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice INV-20270601 discrepancy — duplicate usage lines

Hi Soojin,

We were reconciling May bills and noticed that invoice INV-20270601 (issued 2027-06-01) appears to include duplicate line items for streaming inference usage between 2027-05-12 and 2027-05-18. This inflated our invoice by $4,320 before tax.

I've attached a small CSV (holocene_may_usage.csv) that highlights the two sets of line items we believe are duplicates (lines 14-19 and 67-72 in the invoice export). Can you confirm whether this was a billing engine duplication or an export problem on our side?

Action requested: either (A) reissue INV-20270601 with the duplicate lines removed and a corrected VAT-bearing total, or (B) issue a credit memo for the overcharge and confirm how you will reflect VAT on that credit.

We need the corrected paperwork by the end of next week to meet our month-end close. If you prefer, I'm happy to hop on a quick call with your billing team.

Thanks,
Marcel Dupont
Head of Finance — Holocene Analytics
accounting@holocene-analytics.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: holocene_may_usage.csv (3KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcel Dupont <accounting@holocene-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-20270601 discrepancy — duplicate usage lines

Hi Marcel — thanks for flagging and for the CSV; appreciate the clear pointers. I've looped in Ben from Billing/Collections to investigate.

Quick note on next steps from our side:
- Ben will run a reconciliation against our ingestion logs and billing export to confirm whether lines were duplicated at invoice generation.
- If duplication is confirmed, we'll produce either a corrected invoice or a credit memo (whichever aligns with your accounting preference) and include VAT evidence.
- We'll target an initial response with findings within 48 business hours.

Can you confirm whether Holocene prefers a corrected invoice (reissue) or a credit memo that we mark against the account? Both are fine, but your AP team may have a preference for how you post it.

I'll follow up once Ben has had a look.

Best,
Soogin Lee
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcel Dupont <accounting@holocene-analytics.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-20270601 discrepancy — duplicate usage lines

Marcel — I pulled the billing export and matched it to our raw ingress/usage events. Summary of what I found:

- Root cause: two ingestion jobs from your pipeline retried during a deployment window (2027-05-12 03:22 UTC and 2027-05-12 04:15 UTC). Both produced identical streaming requests; our billing filter did not dedupe a small subset of those records for that 53-minute window.
- Impact: duplicated tokenized calls totaling $4,320 pre-tax. VAT applied to the original invoice at 20% (we will adjust tax accordingly).

Proposed remediation:
1) We can issue a one-time service credit (credit memo) for $4,320 and a VAT adjustment so your net liability is decreased accordingly; or
2) If you require clean bookkeeping with a single corrected document, we can void INV-20270601 and reissue INV-20270601-R1 with corrected lines and totals.

For speed, we prepared a provisional credit memo draft (provisional_credit_memo_draft.pdf) that shows the credit and VAT recalculation. If you accept the credit memo approach, we'll:
- Issue the final credit memo and post it to your account within 2 business days of acceptance.
- Send amended invoice(s) if you need an invoice-level trail showing the credit application.
- Provide VAT evidence (tax calculation worksheet and invoice pairing) as an attachment.

Question: Do you need the credit applied as a refund to your original payment method (requires bank details and a signed acceptance), or is an on-account credit sufficient for your AP team?

I'm attaching the provisional memo for your review.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: provisional_credit_memo_draft.pdf (14KB)

Ben / Soojin — thanks for the quick analysis and the draft. Holocene is happy to accept the credit memo approach. A few final requests before you finalize:

- Please include the VAT calculation worksheet as an attachment to the final credit memo (we need the VAT amount broken out for our reclaim).
- The credit memo should reference the original invoice number (INV-20270601) and show the corrected total after credit.
- We will accept the credit on-account; no refund to the card is necessary. Please apply the credit to our next invoice.
- For our audit file, could you also provide a short note (one paragraph) describing the root cause and the mitigation you put in place so we can attach it to the credit memo?

I've attached a signed acceptance form (holocene_credit_acceptance_signed.pdf) confirming Holocene's approval of the credit memo as the remediation. Our AP contact is: Laura Kent, laura.kent@holocene-analytics.com.

Requested timeline: final credit memo + VAT breakdown and root-cause note by EOD Thursday 2027-06-17.

Appreciate the responsiveness — please let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Marcel Dupont
Head of Finance — Holocene Analytics
